**Status: Master build, automatic candidate publication, and exact loading
verified (2026-10-01); contributor handoff pending.** The first automatically
built candidate reproduced the promoted manager's data and passed the focused
consumer checks. It was loaded online and offline without changing the active
manager. Baseline promotion and ordinary loading are established; the next
exercise is a contributor's section update through review and deliberate
promotion. The operator path and check descriptions live with the code:

- [`scripts/README.md` — HIV Surveillance Manager](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/blob/e1970a72/scripts/README.md#hiv-surveillance-manager):
  upload sections, build, promote, refresh the shared-drive copy, load or pin a version.
- [`data_processing/hiv.surveillance.manager/README.md`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/blob/e1970a72/data_processing/hiv.surveillance.manager/README.md):
  what the build verifies and what its checks mean.
- Workflows: [build](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/blob/e1970a72/.github/workflows/build-hiv-surveillance-manager.yml)
  and [promote](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/blob/e1970a72/.github/workflows/promote-hiv-surveillance-manager.yml).

This page keeps the cross-repository record: what was established, and the
questions that remain open. The full investigation text, including the input
inventory, hosted trials, and baseline-delta review, is preserved in this
wiki's history at
[`587a171`](https://github.com/CIPHER-Epi/jheem-wiki/blob/587a171/investigations/hiv-surveillance-manager-ci.qmd).

## Implemented path and verification

Initially verified against `jheem_analyses@e1970a72` on 2026-09-27;
publication and loader boundaries rechecked at
[`60488abb`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/commit/60488abb9a04a368c9607000f816feb9b2997b5c)
on 2026-09-30.

| Piece | State |
|---|---|
| Section upload | `scripts/upload_hiv_sections.R` publishes a dated, checksummed `hiv-sections-v*` release and moves `hiv-sections-latest` to it. |
| Build | Manual **Build HIV Surveillance Manager** workflow on a GitHub-hosted runner. Inputs: sections, raw data, dependencies, and `jheem2` ref, with `latest`/`dev` defaults. Every download is verified against its published SHA-256, and the release records each input's exact version and digest. |
| Checks | Structural and value comparison against the promoted manager; ten focused consumer checks (Ryan White queries, EHE national prevalence, syphilis adult-population import). A merge error or consumer failure fails the build. |
| Removals | A build that removes structure present in the promoted manager is published as a pre-release marked **Needs review**. Promotion refuses it unless the reviewer confirms the removals. |
| Promotion | Manual **Promote HIV Surveillance Manager** workflow moves `hiv-surveillance-manager-latest`. Building never changes the baseline or commits to the repository. |
| Loading | `SURVEILLANCE.MANAGER` follows `hiv-surveillance-manager-latest` through the same GitHub Releases loader as the syphilis manager (`e1970a72`). A specific build can be pinned with `release.tag`. |

The first promoted version,
[`hiv-surveillance-baseline-2026.09.24`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/releases/tag/hiv-surveillance-baseline-2026.09.24),
is byte-identical to the manager previously distributed through the OneDrive
route (SHA-256 `e282f8cb92c44282efd6ccac2da83e51924818ceee16ef4c010a24dae10350a8`),
so switching the loader changed no data. That manager was produced by applying
the Oakland step (`jheem_analyses@8f4893de`) to the August 31 manager.

A build from `hiv-sections-snapshot-2026.09.23` with all default inputs
(`jheem2@ccb1f9b`, `locations@2481fc44`;
[run 36271434117](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/actions/runs/36271434117))
reproduced its data exactly: 603 of 603 structural checks passed, and none of
408 data arrays differed. The only metadata difference was the stored manager
`name`, which depends on whether the manager was patched in place or merged from
sections. The merge took 25:55 and 7.8 GiB peak resident memory on the hosted
runner.

The later [September 28 build](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/actions/runs/36436325354)
also passed, including itemized review notes and shared data-quality checks.
Those review-branch runs deliberately skipped release publication.

The first [master build](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/actions/runs/36813310513),
from `60488abb`, published
[`hiv-surveillance-manager-v2026.10.01`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/releases/tag/hiv-surveillance-manager-v2026.10.01)
automatically. It passed 603 structural checks and ten consumer checks, with
zero value differences across 408 arrays; only the stored manager `name`
differed. The merge took 25:54 with 7.8 GiB peak resident memory. The release
retains input identities, checksums, the review summary, and validation evidence.
Its manager SHA-256 is
`1c8a71dce22b0c72299c08e929cd4708adc99d3e5dbeb536d5ea64986eb21930`.

Exact-tag loading and offline reload passed in an isolated cache, without
creating a local latest pointer. The remote promoted alias remained on the
September 24 baseline with SHA-256 `e282f8cb92c44282efd6ccac2da83e51924818ceee16ef4c010a24dae10350a8`.
Publication is therefore exercised; promotion remains a separate decision.

Ordinary `latest` loading now uses the verified release cache on `master`
([`7f687a8a`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/commit/7f687a8aa1e01080fa5626c82ed67f673fd9b705),
verified 2026-10-01). Both default and explicit-tag loads attach the resolved
release identity and verify the manager digest. Verified offline reads need no
writer lock; concurrent online updates serialize the local current pointer.
A known corrupt current record fails rather than falling back to an unverified
copy. Legacy-only offline caches retain a warned compatibility fallback until
their first online verified load.

The focused [Linux and Windows checks](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/actions/runs/36813629484)
passed, including migration, corruption, and explicit selection without changing
the current pointer. A live July 27 syphilis-manager download and offline reload
also passed through this shared loader. These checks protect loading and identity,
not the scientific compatibility of a selected manager.

## Release roles (2026-10-01)

A published build is an identified artifact available for review or explicit
loading; it is not automatically the team's default. Promotion selects that
same artifact for the mutable `hiv-surveillance-manager-latest` alias rather
than rebuilding it. GitHub's release/pre-release badge is not the authority for
which manager ordinary analyses load.

| Release | Role |
|---|---|
| `hiv-surveillance-manager-v2026.10.01` | First automatically published master build, with input identities and validation evidence. Not promoted at this checkpoint. |
| `hiv-surveillance-manager-latest` and `hiv-surveillance-baseline-2026.09.24` | The active alias and its immutable source snapshot. Both remain necessary to resolve and identify the current default. |
| `hiv-sections-latest` and `hiv-sections-snapshot-2026.09.23` | The section-input alias and the exact snapshot consumed by the published build; not duplicate final managers. |
| `hiv-surveillance-baseline-2026.08.31` | Historical baseline from before the Oakland update, retained for comparisons. |
| `hiv-surveillance-candidate-2026.09.24-r35952637832` | Earlier development trial reproducing the August baseline; historical evidence rather than the current candidate. |

The [earlier candidate](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/releases/tag/hiv-surveillance-candidate-2026.09.24-r35952637832)
retains the comparison with August 26 data. It predates the current build
naming convention: the
[promotion workflow at `3f463e2a`](https://github.com/tfojo1/jheem_analyses/blob/3f463e2ab274e4d5e24decdf82f294a91b628857/.github/workflows/promote-hiv-surveillance-manager.yml)
accepts `manager-v*` and `baseline-*` tags, not that old `candidate-*` tag.
The October 1 build is data-identical to the active baseline, but has a different
serialized digest and stored manager name; it is not a byte-for-byte duplicate.

## Boundaries of the claim

- This is **section-to-final** automation. Sections are still built locally
  from shared-drive raw data. A change to a section-processing script is tested
  only after that section is rebuilt and uploaded.
- The build doesn't write to shared storage. After promotion, the shared-drive
  copy that syphilis section builds read must be refreshed by hand.
- R is pinned to 4.4.2; other R packages are recorded in `session_info.txt`
  but not locked.
- The consumer checks are focused queries, not full calibrations.
- Reproducing a baseline records existing behavior. It doesn't certify
  scientific correctness.

## Open questions

- **Section lineage.** Which processing revisions and raw inputs produced each
  of the five snapshotted sections remains unrecorded. Sections 1–4 were last
  written August 24–26 and section 5 on May 13.
- **Massachusetts adult population.** Between the August 26 and August 31
  managers, adult-population values for `MA.1`, `MA.4`, and `MA.5` changed
  (10,810 cells across 13 arrays; for example, 2023 `MA.4` moved from 692,751
  to 2,097,024). The cause and scientific intent haven't been established; the
  promoted manager carries the August 31 values.
- **Promotion gate depth.** Which full-model scenarios, if any, should gate
  promotion beyond the focused consumer checks.
- **Raw-to-section automation.** Bringing section builds into CI one at a time
  once their inputs and runtime are measured.
- **Syphilis alignment.** The syphilis build still exposes moving inputs without
  recording their resolved versions, gates on a repository spec file that its
  build commits to `master`, and reads the HIV manager from a hand-uploaded
  `data-managers-*` release. Aligning it with this pattern is recorded in
  [D-022](../decisions.qmd#d-022).
